title: Paranormal investigation to take place at one of Wyre Forest's 'most haunted pubs'
excerpt: An overnight paranormal investigation is set to take place in one of the 'most haunted pubs' in Wyre Forest that has a 'dark' history.
content:

An overnight paranormal investigation is set to take place in one of the 'most haunted pubs' in Wyre Forest that has a 'dark' history.

The paranormal investigation will take place at The Wharf in Stourport on Saturday, November 21.

The event will start at 11.55pm and will run until 6am the following morning.

According to The Wharf, the event will feature a 'full overnight investigation' and will be for over 16s only.

Writing on social media, The Wharf said: “Join The Haunted Historian team for the first paranormal investigation at this exclusive location.

“The venue's dark history is steeped in tragedy and sorrow.

“This overnight event combines historical research with paranormal investigation techniques as you explore one of the area's most haunted sites.

“Expect to uncover compelling evidence and hear untold stories from the past.

“Not for the faint-hearted.”

Tickets for the event will cost £35.
